recruiterCard.summary: Built an AI-assisted recipe and nutrition platform that combines FastAPI services, OpenAI-powered generation, React UI flows, and normalized PostgreSQL persistence.
impactBullets: Built a FastAPI backend with REST endpoints to parse ingredients and generate AI recipes using OpenAI APIs.
Designed normalized PostgreSQL schemas for users and recipes, enabling scalable persistence and query performance.
Built React flows for recipe and nutrition experiences while containerizing the stack for reproducible deployment.
Shipped AI-generated recipe responses with sub-200ms endpoint latency.
